features.name: Remembered favors
features.description: The keeper remembers an introduction and a repaired lantern. This human-authored mapping connects explicit state to the dialogue that explains it.

features.name: Earned passage
features.description: A passage is granted only after both required actions and sufficient trust. A named feature links the gameplay objective to its rules.

features.name: A responsive harbor
features.description: The scene lights the lantern and moves the boat according to game state. Rendering is separated from the rules.
